An error in a function of a loaded module shows frames in both files.
-- main.star --
load("lib.star", "check")
def run(n):
    return check(n) + 1
print(run(1))
print(run(-1))
-- lib.star --
def check(n):
    if n < 0:
        fail("negative: %d" % n)
    return helper(n)

def helper(n):
    return n * 10
